You know Neuro-sama, the AI that streams games and chats with thousands of fans live? She's closed source, so when the stream ends, she's gone. Meet Airi, the open-source version you actually own and run yourself.
Airi is a fully autonomous AI companion with an animated avatar. It talks to you in real time, remembers past conversations, and yes, it actually plays games with you. Tell it to build a cabin in Minecraft and it plans the path, gathers resources, and builds it.
Here's what you get out of the box:
-Real-time voice chat with sub-500ms response time
-Animated Live2D or 3D avatar with blinking and emotion expressions
-Plays Minecraft and Factorio autonomously
-Discord and Telegram integration
-30+ LLM providers supported, swap models with one config change
It runs on Web, Desktop, and Mobile. No cloud required. Swap the AI brain anytime, from Claude to a local Ollama model. It's free, MIT licensed, and already has 17.5k stars on GitHub.

❗️Satya Nadella just picked a side in AI’s biggest debate.

Microsoft says open-weight AI models are critical to keeping America competitive.

Here’s why:

If only a handful of companies own the most powerful AI models, they also control the prices, access, infrastructure, and ultimately the future of AI.

Open-weight models flip that equation.

Developers can download them, customize them, run them on their own hardware, and build products without relying on a single AI provider.

Of course, that comes with security risks.

But Microsoft argues that putting the future of AI in the hands of just a few closed labs could be an even greater danger.

China has launched production of deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machines for the first time.

According to available information, the country plans to produce five DUV units this year and increase output to 20 units in the following year. DUV lithography is key for advanced semiconductor manufacturing, a sector historically dominated by ASML, which previously held an effective monopoly.

The announcement has had an immediate impact on global chip equipment stocks. ASML shares dropped by 8.3%, ASM International by 7.3%, BE Semiconductor by 9.9%, Applied Materials by 6.7%, and Lam Research by 7.9%.

🧠 Neuralink demos mind-controlled wheelchair

Neuralink showed participants in clinical trials controlling an electric wheelchair using only their thoughts. An implant reads movement intentions in real time and moves a cursor on a screen to direct the chair.

The cursor controls an app displaying a live camera feed from the wheelchair’s perspective. Moving the cursor up drives forward, down reverses, left and right steer, and pushing the cursor further increases speed.

This “telepathic wheelchair control” is still early stage but aims to restore independent mobility for people with paralysis. Even moving around a room without help is a big step.

❗️Microsoft says it takes "18 months to build a data center but 8 years to get a grid connection" in Britain.

It was revealed that Britain has just 2GW of data center capacity, a third of America's per person. 

The UK hopes to reach 6GW by 2030 while America targets over 90GW, per The Economist.
